summary: Strong B2.3 keystone. Expanded_walkthrough names a real G1 misconception (make-ten breaks when the larger addend is on the right) and explicitly bridges to Lesson 1's commutative property. Three named strategies with double ten-frames carrying meaning, plus a count-on stretch surfacing strategy choice. Everyday materials; for_movement_learners gives a no-paper body path. Doubles the Robot anchors minds_on, all success_criteria use 'I can'. Worksheet Part 4 is a true transfer task and accepts legitimate alternatives (7+8 = NEAR-DOUBLE or MAKE-TEN).
